description: Structural superposition of the Oca6 AlphaFold model onto the citrate-bound Siw14 crystal structure, and transfer of the anion into the Oca6 frame
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def read(fn, chain=None):
    rows=[]
    for l in open(fn):
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            if chain and l[21]!=chain: continue
            rows.append(dict(rec=l[:6].strip(),name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],
                             num=int(l[22:26]),x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),z=float(l[46:54]),b=float(l[60:66])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

F=read("siw14_6byf_chainA.pdb","A")          # Siw14 catalytic domain + citrate (experimental)
M=read("oca6_af.pdb")                         # Oca6 AlphaFold model

# Correspondences from the P-loop register established by two independent alignments
# (my NW/BLOSUM62 and phenix BLOSUM50): Siw14 C214 <-> Oca6 C114, i.e. offset -100 in the P-loop block.
# Build anchors from the structurally equivalent DSP core using an offset-scan on CA positions.
def ca(df):
    d=df[(df.rec=="ATOM")&(df.name=="CA")]
    return {int(r.num):np.array([r.x,r.y,r.z]) for r in d.itertuples()}, {int(r.num):r.res for r in d.itertuples()}
caF,resF=ca(F); caM,resM=ca(M)

def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0)
    H=(P-Pc).T@(Q-Qc); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); D=np.diag([1,1,d])
    R=Vt.T@D@U.T; t=Qc-R@Pc
    return R,t

# seed on the P-loop + flanking beta strand / helix (offset -100), then iteratively extend
seed=[(s, s-100) for s in range(205,235) if s in caF and (s-100) in caM]
pairs=seed
for it in range(12):
    P=np.array([caM[m] for _,m in pairs]); Q=np.array([caF[f] for f,_ in pairs])
    R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
    Mt={k:R@v+t for k,v in caM.items()}
    # greedy nearest-neighbour matching with monotonicity-free cutoff
    cand=[]
    for f,qf in caF.items():
        best=None
        for m,qm in Mt.items():
            d=np.linalg.norm(qm-qf)
            if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,m)
        if best and best[0]<4.0: cand.append((f,best[1],best[0]))
    # keep unique moving residues (lowest distance)
    seen={}
    for f,m,d in cand:
        if m not in seen or d<seen[m][1]: seen[m]=(f,d)
    newpairs=sorted([(f,m) for m,(f,d) in seen.items()])
    if newpairs==pairs: break
    pairs=newpairs
P=np.array([caM[m] for _,m in pairs]); Q=np.array([caF[f] for f,_ in pairs])
R,t=kabsch(P,Q); dd=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1)
print(f"Structure superposition Oca6(AF) onto Siw14 6BYF chain A")
print(f"  aligned CA pairs = {len(pairs)}   core RMSD = {np.sqrt((dd**2).mean()):.2f} A   median dev = {np.median(dd):.2f} A")
print(f"  Siw14 residues covered: {min(f for f,_ in pairs)}-{max(f for f,_ in pairs)} of 113-281")
chk=[(f,m) for f,m in pairs if f in (213,214,215,216,217,218,219,220,221)]
print("  P-loop correspondence (Siw14 -> Oca6):",
      ", ".join(f"{resF[f][:3]}{f}->{resM[m][:3]}{m}" for f,m in chk))

# ---- transfer the experimental citrate into the Oca6 frame ----
CIT=F[(F.res=="CIT")][["x","y","z"]].values
Rinv=R.T; tinv=-R.T@t
CIT_in_M=(Rinv@CIT.T).T+tinv
allM=M[M.rec=="ATOM"].copy()
D=np.linalg.norm(allM[["x","y","z"]].values[:,None,:]-CIT_in_M[None,:,:],axis=2)
allM["d"]=D.min(axis=1)
nearM=allM[allM.d<5.0].groupby(["num","res"]).agg(dmin=("d","min"),plddt=("b","first")).reset_index().sort_values("dmin")
print("\nOca6 residues that would line the Siw14 anion (citrate) site after superposition (<5.0 A):")
print(nearM.to_string(index=False))

allF=F[F.rec=="ATOM"].copy()
DF=np.linalg.norm(allF[["x","y","z"]].values[:,None,:]-CIT[None,:,:],axis=2)
allF["d"]=DF.min(axis=1)
nearF=allF[allF.d<5.0].groupby(["num","res"]).d.min().reset_index().sort_values("d")
print("\nSiw14 residues lining the same site in the crystal (<5.0 A):")
print(nearF.to_string(index=False))

CH={"ARG":1,"LYS":1,"HIS":0.1,"ASP":-1,"GLU":-1}
qM=sum(CH.get(r.res,0) for r in nearM.itertuples()); qF=sum(CH.get(r.res,0) for r in nearF.itertuples())
print(f"\nNet side-chain charge of the anion-site shell (<5 A): Siw14 {qF:+.1f} (n={len(nearF)}), Oca6 {qM:+.1f} (n={len(nearM)})")

# ---- figure: P-loop position-by-position comparison ----
sw=[(213,"H"),(214,"C"),(215,"N"),(216,"R"),(217,"G"),(218,"K"),(219,"H"),(220,"R"),(221,"T")]
oc=[(113,"H"),(114,"C"),(115,"T"),(116,"N"),(117,"G"),(118,"E"),(119,"L"),(120,"I"),(121,"I")]
cit_d=[]
for n,_ in sw:
    s=F[(F.num==n)&(F.rec=="ATOM")][["x","y","z"]].values
    cit_d.append(np.linalg.norm(s[:,None,:]-CIT[None,:,:],axis=2).min())
oca_d=[]
for n,_ in oc:
    s=M[(M.num==n)&(M.rec=="ATOM")][["x","y","z"]].values
    oca_d.append(np.linalg.norm(s[:,None,:]-CIT_in_M[None,:,:],axis=2).min())
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.6))
x=np.arange(9); w=0.38
b1=ax.bar(x-w/2,cit_d,w,label="Siw14/Oca3 (6BYF, citrate bound)",color="#4C72B0")
b2=ax.bar(x+w/2,oca_d,w,label="Oca6 (AlphaFold, superposed)",color="#C44E52")
ax.axhline(4.0,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1)
ax.text(8.4,4.12,"4 A contact cutoff",fontsize=8,color="grey",ha="right")
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{a[1]}{a[0]}\n{b[1]}{b[0]}" for a,b in zip(sw,oc)],fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("P-loop position (top: Siw14, bottom: equivalent Oca6 residue)")
ax.set_ylabel("closest atom to the bound anion (A)")
ax.set_title("Siw14 P-loop residues clamp a bound citrate; the Oca6 equivalents are hydrophobic or acidic")
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(sw,oc)):
    col="#4C72B0" if a[1] in "RKH" else "k"; 
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

pd.DataFrame(dict(siw14_res=[f"{a[1]}{a[0]}" for a in sw], oca6_res=[f"{b[1]}{b[0]}" for b in oc],
                  siw14_dist_to_citrate=np.round(cit_d,2), oca6_dist_to_modelled_anion=np.round(oca_d,2))
            ).to_csv("ploop_anion_contacts.csv",index=False)
print("\nwrote ploop_anion_contacts.csv")
